listing.summary: My portrait pack. I wanted something close to vanilla style. I'm also including some AI generated photos expanding the available character pool, but I'll eventually edit these manually to match the enhanced art style.
listing.aiSummary: Expands the available character pool with new semi-realistic portraits.
listing.partOfThreadTitle: [0.98a] Edited Vanilla Portraits plus some extras

description: My portrait pack. I wanted something close to vanilla style. I'm also including some AI generated photos expanding the available character pool, but I'll eventually edit these manually to match the enhanced art style. For those who want to have the Additional Portraits show up in the Player Portrait, just modify the player faction file from the Edited Vanilla Portraits mod or add a player faction file to the Additional Portraits mod.
